sn35.189-191:0.3: 1. 17. 22-24. atīta dukkha, anāgata dukkha, paccuppanna dukkhasuttāni
sn35.189-191:1.1: cakkhuṃ bhikkhave dukkhaṃ atītaṃ anāgataṃ paccuppannaṃ, sotaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ …pe… jivhā dukkhā atītā anāgatā paccuppannā, kāyo …pe… mano dukkho atīto anāgato paccuppanno.
sn35.189-191:1.2: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati …pe…
